text:
cassie: Following up on the postmortem: we're still observing a small but persistent spike of TLS handshake retries on cross-region paths (us-east-1 -> eu-west-1). Need clear owners, specific remediation steps, and realistic timelines.

omar: I'll take the routing-rule and LB config remediation. Suspect the weighted routing fallback isn't honoring sticky routes during scale events. Will run a 5% canary with sanity probes. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

jun: I'll own telemetry, alerts, and the replay tests to reproduce the retry pattern. Need to ensure sample rate for retries isn't auto-sampled down. ETA: 3 days.

maya: I'll own fallback/backpressure policy (token-bucket handshake throttle + explicit faster failover to regional path). Planning a staged rollout: lab -> canary -> global. ETA: 5 days.

omar: snippet from the edge logs I pulled this morning: 
```
2026-03-22T02:14:08Z lb-router us-east-1 -> eu-west-1 TLS handshake timeout retries=12 backend=lb-ps-3 conn=0x7f8a
2026-03-22T02:14:09Z lb-router fallback-path initiated region=eu-central-1 latency_ms=312
```

jun: query I'll use to baseline the signal: 
```
select count(*) from lb_conn where retries > 1 and src_region='us-east-1' and dst_region='eu-west-1' and ts > now() - interval '6 hours';
```

maya: note on recurrence: this tends to crop up during cross-region scaleups + small TLS cipher negotiation mismatches. Adding a CI job to run handshake matrix during scale tests.

cassie: action items created in tracker: SRE-2342 (routing/lb rule) assigned to Omar, SRE-2343 (telemetry/alerts) assigned to Jun, SRE-2344 (fallback/backpressure) assigned to Maya. Link the canary plans and runbook. Reconvene in 24h for quick status. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Created tasks <https://tasks.redwood/s/SRE-2342|SRE-2342>, <https://tasks.redwood/s/SRE-2343|SRE-2343>, <https://tasks.redwood/s/SRE-2344|SRE-2344>. Due dates: 2026-03-24, 2026-03-25, 2026-03-28 UTC.

omar: launching canary now: `deploy --service lb-router --canary 5% --image sha:abc123`  will post results in ~20m.

jun: alert plan: add metric lb.cross_region_retries.rate with threshold = baseline * 5 over 10m, add runbook link, and add a suppression window for canary windows. Also adding a dashboard tile for retries by cipher-suite.

maya: staging plan: enable token-bucket handshake limit on canary only, monitor 95p latency and error-rate delta, then ramp.

cassie: thanks team. Quick checklist: 1) Confirm canary probe success (Omar) 2) Confirm new alert/dash is live (Jun) 3) Post canary rollback criteria and ramp plan (Maya) 4) Add CI handshake matrix (ops). Update the SRE tickets if ETAs change.

omar: canary looks good so far -> 0.8% retries vs 1.6% baseline in last 30m. Posting more detailed logs to the ticket.

jun: telemetry patch landed to staging dashboard, wiring to pager. I'll run the replay tonight and post artifacts.

maya: started lab work on token-bucket config, will validate throttle behavior under synthetic scale.

cassie: ok recheck in 24h. If this recurs after these fixes, we'll escalate to a deeper routing-algo postmortem.
